# AmyMind

> AmyMind is a free AI-powered mind map generator that converts documents, videos, and text into visual mind maps with support for multiple formats and languages.

AmyMind provides a suite of document-to-mindmap conversion tools including PDF, Word, Markdown, and YouTube converters, with 50+ templates and competitive pricing at $45/year. The platform emphasizes AI-powered document analysis, batch processing, and multilingual support across English, Chinese, and Spanish.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered mind mapping

- PDF to mind map
- Text to mind map
- Markdown conversion
- Word/DOC converter
- YouTube to mind map
- Mind map templates
- Export formats (SVG, PNG, PPT)

## Document Conversion Tools

- [AI PDF to Mind Map Generator | Free PDF Converter – AmyMind](https://amymind.com/tools/pdf-to-mind-map): Free PDF to mind map converter using NLP and OCR technology with batch processing
- [AI Text to Mind Map Generator | Free Online Tool – AmyMind](https://amymind.com/tools/text-to-mind-map): Free text to mind map generator with multilingual NLP support (English, Chinese, Spanish)
- [AI Markdown to Mind Map Generator | Free Converter Tool – AmyMind](https://amymind.com/tools/markdown-to-mind-map): Free markdown to mind map converter with batch processing and multiple export formats
- [AI Word to Mind Map Generator | Free DOC Converter – AmyMind](https://amymind.com/tools/word-to-mind-map): Free Word/DOC/DOCX to mind map converter with AI-powered document analysis
- [YouTube to Mind Map — Free AI Converter | AmyMind](https://amymind.com/tools/youtube-to-mind-map): Convert YouTube videos to mind maps using AI video summarization and caption analysis
